summary.text: Cyndie Hutchings is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 138, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an anti-data center activist and one of the leaders of the Troup County Anti-Data Center Coalition.

paragraphs.text: Hutchings said in the survey that her coalition work secured some of the strongest data center ordinances in the state for Troup County residents.

She listed ending corporate welfare, lowering utility bills, Medicaid expansion, greater access to health care including incentives to attract more obstetrician-gynecologists, and legislation to increase the housing supply as her priorities.
Hutchings named Georgia Conservation Voters and Fighting Fifty among the organizations that have endorsed her campaign.
